title: The entrance
steps: You and {friend} have just come in through the great door. The entrance hall is huge and bright, with a thick red carpet and suits of armour shining in the torchlight. It is so warm after the chilly night outside.
Welcome to Arvelia! I am Ilda, one of your teachers, and I look after all the first-year pupils.
As you saw at the gate, this castle listens to those who give it the right instructions. But it is very late to learn more magic tonight!
This place is huge! We are very tired, where do we sleep?
I cannot wait to see everything tomorrow!
Follow me, please. I will take you to the first-years' dormitory.
You follow Ilda across the hall, {friend} walking right beside you, under a giant chandelier that sparkles like stars.
It is not far at all, and your warm beds are waiting for you.
